name: Carl Craig
hook: Learned the music from Derrick May's radio show, then became his assistant, before splitting into half a dozen aliases so no single sound would have to carry his name.
blurb: Carl Craig grew up in Detroit listening to Derrick May's radio show, and became May's assistant at his label, Transmat, the clearest second-wave case of Detroit techno's own apprenticeship system, the same artist-to-artist handing on that built the first wave. His first record, 'Elements', came out under the name Psyche in 1989. In 1991 he started his own label, Planet E. He used a different name for each sound: Psyche for ambient work, 69 for harder techno, Paperclip People for house, Innerzone Orchestra for jazzier material, treating his identity itself as a production tool.

signatureTracks.title: Elements (Psyche)
signatureTracks.whyThisOne: His first release, made at Transmat under May's mentorship and later collected on the compilation 'Elements 1989-1990.'

signatureTracks.title: Bug in the Bass Bin (69)
signatureTracks.whyThisOne: One of the most enduring club records to come out of Detroit's second wave, made under the harder '69' alias.
